title: Antigravity parity tests and doctor diagnostics
description: Done when: parity tests pass on fixtures and doctor reports both roots.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Parity covered by 7 lib unit tests (discovery, doctor flags missing transcripts, type mapping incl. checkpoint/error flags, step_index ordering, payload-DB tool linkage, hot-DB snapshot read with live WAL, malformed/unknown skip counting) plus 7 executable BDD scenarios (wip tag dropped; wording adjusted to keep step regexes distinct: 'the Antigravity importer ...', 'extraction maps N good records', 'the live app kept writing rows without interference'). Full gate green.

right_now_summary: Parity tests run on fixtures, and doctor checks both roots.
